sentences.text: This creature belongs to the sphenosuchians, an early branch of crocodylomorphs within the reptile class.
Its fossil remains include a skull and jaws featuring some unique, leaf-shaped teeth similar to those of plant-eating dinosaurs.
The front row of its mouth held five or six sharp, backward-curving teeth.
The species, named P. lufengensis, was described in 2000 by Jerald Harris and colleagues based on a tiny, incomplete skull measuring just 71.4 mm.
It inhabited the Sinemurian age, living between 199.5 and 192.9 million years ago in Yunnan, China.
